title: Prologue: Rise of the Ice
beat: Nekron masters the black arts; glacier advances southward, driving humanity toward Fire Keep.

title: Fall of the North Village
beat: The glacier and subhuman horde overrun Larn's village.

title: The Ice Throne Council
beat: Juliana and Nekron celebrate the fall of North Village and prepare envoys to demand Fire Keep's surrender.

title: Teegra's Lessons
beat: Jarol denies Teegra's request to join the war council; she vents to Shaitan.

title: The Envoy & The Abduction
beat: Taro and Jarol reject Nekron's demands; subhumans kidnap Teegra, prompting a Dragonhawk pursuit.

title: Nekron's Fury
beat: Scouts report Teegra escaped; Nekron executes the failure and orders recapture.

title: Wilderness Campfire
beat: Teegra and Larn meet by a campfire; both flee southward from Nekron's cold.

title: Ambush & The Rescue Track
beat: Subhumans recapture Teegra and wound Larn; Larn is tended by an ally and they mount a decoy chase.

title: Taro's Diplomatic Mission
beat: Jarol commands a reluctant Taro to travel to Ice Peak under a truce to negotiate Teegra's release.

title: Roliel's Cottage
beat: Roliel shelters an exhausted Teegra, discovers Nekron wants her, and sends Otwa to sell her to the subhumans.

title: The Dying Hearth
beat: Larn finds Roliel mortally betrayed by the subhumans; she reveals Teegra is being taken to Akatar.

title: Akatar Docks
beat: Subhumans force Teegra onto a galley bound north for Ice Peak before dawn.

title: The Unwanted Bride
beat: Juliana presents Teegra as a bride; Nekron rejects marriage and peace with contempt.

title: The Envoy's Execution
beat: Taro arrives under a flag of truce; Nekron murders Taro in cold blood.

title: Dungeon Infiltration
beat: Larn attacks Nekron and is imprisoned; Teegra attempts to pick the cell lock.

title: The King's Resolve
beat: Jarol receives news of Taro's death; with the glacier closing, he mobilizes the Dragonhawks.

title: Climax & Renewal
beat: Dragonhawks and lava assault Ice Peak; Nekron is defeated, leaving Larn and Teegra to start over.
